summary: Configured FreeRADIUS on node1 for the dedicated node2 client and demonstration user. Correct credentials receive Access-Accept, incorrect credentials receive Access-Reject, and requests using an incorrect client secret are not accepted. Configuration, firewall access, and authentication survived serial restarts of both nodes. The handover files, AlmaLinux release, and kernel remain intact.
actions_performed: Installed FreeRADIUS 3.0.27 on node1 and the compatible client utility on node2.
Configured node2 (10.100.70.11) as a dedicated RADIUS client using the handover secret.
Configured the demonstration user from access.txt.
Enabled radiusd and persistent UDP/1812 firewall access.
Validated all three authentication outcomes before and after restarts.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated client and demonstration user configuration
evidence.summary: Confirms the client IP, secret match, user match, protected configuration permissions, valid syntax, active/enabled service, and UDP/1812 listeners.
Shows Access-Accept for correct credentials, Access-Reject for an altered password, and no accepted response with an altered client secret, including after both restarts.
Matching handover checksums and permissions persisted on both nodes; AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 remained unchanged.
Captures healthy baseline and authentication, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered radiusd/firewall/data, and successful post-restart authentication.
Captures healthy baseline and authentication, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered client utility/route/data, and all required post-restart authentication outcomes.
